0.original: Sphene would take you back to the outskirts.

26.original: Speak with the people of the outskirts.

32.original: Speak with Erenville in the Earthen Sky hideout.

49.original: Perhaps we should head back to the outskirts? I daresay your friends will also have returned by now.

50.original: My thanks again for dealing with the fiends. Come and visit us any time.

53.original: There is so much of Alexandria I would love to show you!

54.original: Like everyone, I have the utmost admiration and respect for Queen Sphene. It's a little embarrassing to say such things to her in person, though...

55.original: What's going on? How could Pepoane suddenly forget about Namikka?

56.original: It's as if he never knew her...

57.original: Could the same thing have happened to others as well, I wonder?

58.original: There's only one way to find out. Let's make inquiries about Namikka in the area. We can reconvene afterwards at the aetheryte.

60.original: As far as I could tell, Pepoane genuinely had no recollection of Namikka.

61.original: We'll see how it is with other people.

62.original: I've never seen nor heard of anything like this before.

64.original: I'm afraid I don't know that person. I'm sorry I couldn't be of help.

65.original: I'm sorry. Perhaps someone else knows this Namikka.

66.original: What's that? Do I know a Namikka?

67.original: Never met anyone by that name, and I've worked at the outskirts for a good while now. If she'd spent time here, I would remember.

68.original: Like as not, this Namikka is up in the cloud...

69.original: Hmmm... I do recall caring for someone until recently. And you say that it was a woman named Namikka?

70.original: While I can't say for certain if it was her, I wouldn't worry. I'm sure she's just been taken up to the cloud.

71.original: It's not common, but it does happen from time to time.

72.original: So it was the same for everyone.

73.original: Not a single person remembers Namikka. It's as if the memory of her has been purged from their minds.

74.original: While such a thing might be done with magic, to alter the memories of so many at once would be a tremendous undertaking. We would have felt a surge of aether corresponding to the act, too, and I sensed none in that moment.

75.original: Neither did I. But I did notice something else─right before Pepoane seemingly forgot, a light in the device on his head began to blink.

76.original: Could there be a connection? Someone also said something about “soul cells.”

77.original: But who might we ask about this? If we continued making such inquiries, I expect we would only cause confusion.

78.original: Indeed... If we can't readily solve the mystery about Namikka, perhaps we could search for Cahciua instead?

79.original: Sphene said to try the Thunderyards.

80.original: It should be in this direction.

83.original: Another kind of mechanical soldier!? It looks dangerous! We'd better destroy it!

86.original: I think it understood our words. It might be worth asking it some questions.

87.original: ...Erenville? Are you alright? You look like you've seen a ghost.

89.original: Well, it went off in the direction we're headed anyway, so let's try to track it down.

92.original: No sign of it over here.

96.original: To the northeast? Then it must be bound for the mines.

98.original: It could well be a trap, so let's not rush in too quickly.

100.original: I think it's safe to assume it went into the mines.

101.original: An old coal mine? It appears to have long since been abandoned, like so many other places.

102.original: The stones in those crates... Could it be turquoise?

103.original: I heard faint voices coming from inside.

104.original: So it's not alone. But we're still going in, of course?

105.original: This may be a trap. Be ready for a fight, everyone!

107.original: I'm not worried. We've had to improvise countless times before, after all.

108.original: A device made with electrope. It seems to be the only one here.

109.original: It would appear no one has worked these tunnels in quite some time...

110.original: I can hear them. Several people up ahead.

111.original: Hmm. I can't make out their conversation with the echoing.

112.original: Let's keep going. Stay on your guard.

113.original: I can't say I understand what's going on, but at least Cahciua is safe.

114.original: Erenville's mother is a floating machine. Right─that makes about as much sense as everything else thus far.

115.original: At this point, I doubt anything could possibly surprise me.

116.original: The Allagans had machines that could be controlled remotely. Is she using something similar to communicate with us?

117.original: Always too much excitement with her... Sorry for drawing our weapons on you.

118.original: If it's any consolation, this is all rather confusing to us as well.

121.original: As far as I can tell, this is indeed my mother. I can think of few people in the world quite so spirited...

122.original: But as to what's happened, we'll need to ask her...
